task: Let's get Zoho Desk set up for our customer support. I need to create three new support tickets, assign them, and resolve them. Then, set up a custom view to track urgent issues and create a report on our weekly ticket resolution times. Finally, update one of the resolved tickets with a new internal note.

observations.what: The Desk sign-up page rejected the email with the inline error 'Email address cannot contain the + character', so no account could be created.
The general Zoho account register page (accounts.zoho.com/register) has the same '+' email ban and also asks for a mobile number up front.
Clicking 'Signup for free' on the Desk home page opened a 'Book your demo / Request a call back' popup instead of the sign-up form.
I filled the Desk form before seeing the '+' error and then had to switch pages, which used about 12 of the 39 steps; the server's no-plus address option is not available without a token.
